title: Cleanroom Factory Tool Event Ingestion (5k Tools)
prompt: Event ingestion for 5,000 wafer fabrication factory tools, strictly on-premise deployment, <1s end-to-end latency for anomaly detection, maintained by a small 3-person ops team.
options: NATS JetStream (Clustered Go Single-Binary) or Redpanda
Apache Kafka on Kubernetes with Strimzi Operator (KRaft mode)
Raw Self-Managed Apache Kafka + ZooKeeper + Flink Cluster
AWS Kinesis Data Streams + Cloud Lambda Bridge
expert_choice: NATS JetStream (Clustered Go Single-Binary) or Redpanda
acceptable_secondary: Apache Kafka on Kubernetes with Strimzi Operator (KRaft mode)
expert_rationale: With a 3-person ops team on-prem and 50k events/sec (<1s latency), NATS JetStream or Redpanda provides single-binary simplicity without JVM tuning, while Strimzi Kafka is acceptable if Kubernetes is already mature. Raw Kafka+ZK is too heavy, and AWS Kinesis violates on-prem data sovereignty.

title: Wafer Metrology Time-Series Storage & Relational Defect Joins
prompt: Store 80,000 sensor metrics/sec from metrology stations on-premise and frequently join them with relational lot/wafer metadata in PostgreSQL. Ops team of 4 engineers already knows PostgreSQL deeply.
options: TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL Hypertables + Native Compression)
ClickHouse Cluster + Separate PostgreSQL + Debezium Sync
Apache Cassandra + Apache Spark Cluster
InfluxDB v1 Custom Sharded Cluster
expert_choice: TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL Hypertables + Native Compression)
acceptable_secondary: ClickHouse Cluster + Separate PostgreSQL + Debezium Sync
expert_rationale: At 80k metrics/sec with heavy relational metadata joins and a 4-person PostgreSQL-skilled team, TimescaleDB satisfies throughput while keeping a single database engine and zero cross-DB sync pipelines.

title: B2B Equipment Spare-Parts Portal Modernization
prompt: Build a new B2B spare-parts ordering and inventory portal for 2,000 concurrent users. Team of 5 full-stack developers, 4-month deadline, evolving domain boundaries, no dedicated SRE.
options: Modular Monolith with Explicit Domain Boundaries & Single PostgreSQL
12 Fine-Grained Microservices with Istio Service Mesh & Polyglot DBs
Serverless Nano-Functions (80+ Lambdas) with DynamoDB
Event-Sourced CQRS Distributed Cluster with Axon Server
expert_choice: Modular Monolith with Explicit Domain Boundaries & Single PostgreSQL
acceptable_secondary: Serverless Nano-Functions (80+ Lambdas) with DynamoDB
expert_rationale: For a 5-developer team with no SRE and a 4-month deadline, a Modular Monolith avoids distributed systems tax while enforcing module boundaries for future extraction.

title: Multi-Step Wafer Lot Hold & Calibration Workflow
prompt: Coordinate an 8-step automated workflow when a wafer lot fails inline inspection (pause tool, quarantine lot, schedule calibration, notify engineer, run test wafer, compensating rollback on timeout). Full audit visibility required.
options: Orchestrated Saga via Durable Workflow Engine (Temporal / State Machine)
Pure Event Choreography across 8 Services via Pub/Sub Topics
Distributed Two-Phase Commit (2PC/XA) across All 8 Systems
Cron-Job Batch Polling Script every 15 Minutes
expert_choice: Orchestrated Saga via Durable Workflow Engine (Temporal / State Machine)
acceptable_secondary: Pure Event Choreography across 8 Services via Pub/Sub Topics
expert_rationale: For an 8-step workflow with timeouts and compensating rollbacks, an Orchestrated Saga (Temporal/State Machine) prevents cyclic event spaghetti and gives a centralized audit trail.

title: Remote Assembly Sub-Plant Telemetry over Unreliable WAN
prompt: Collect high-frequency packaging machine telemetry from a remote assembly site whose WAN link to central HQ drops for 2-4 hours during storms. Zero data loss and local sub-second safety alerts required.
options: Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway (Local NATS Leaf / SQLite Buffer)
Direct Synchronous REST Calls from Machines to Central HQ Cloud
Remote Kafka Producers writing directly over WAN with large RAM buffers
Nightly FTP CSV Batch Upload
expert_choice: Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway (Local NATS Leaf / SQLite Buffer)
acceptable_secondary: Remote Kafka Producers writing directly over WAN with large RAM buffers
expert_rationale: An Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway processes local safety alerts in <1s and persists data to local disk during 4-hour WAN outages, syncing asynchronously upon reconnection.

title: Dual-Write Consistency between Order DB and Notification Broker
prompt: Ensure that whenever a customer order status is updated in PostgreSQL, an event is reliably published to the message broker without losing messages on process crash. Team of 3 backend devs wants minimal extra infrastructure.
options: Transactional Outbox Table with Lightweight Polling Publisher
Transactional Outbox with Full Debezium + Kafka Connect Cluster
Dual Write in Application Code (DB commit then Broker publish)
Distributed XA Transaction across PostgreSQL and Broker
expert_choice: Transactional Outbox Table with Lightweight Polling Publisher
acceptable_secondary: Transactional Outbox with Full Debezium + Kafka Connect Cluster
expert_rationale: Transactional Outbox with a lightweight Polling Publisher guarantees at-least-once consistency using only PostgreSQL, avoiding the operational burden of running a Debezium + Kafka Connect cluster for a 3-person team.

title: Legacy 20-Year-Old Factory ERP Displacement
prompt: Replace a monolithic 20-year-old legacy ERP system handling live factory inventory. Zero downtime allowed during the 18-month transition; cannot freeze new feature delivery.
options: Strangler Fig Pattern with Routing Facade & Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)
Big-Bang Rewrite from Scratch with Weekend Cutover
Shared Database Direct Table Mutation between Legacy and New Apps
Lift-and-Shift Legacy Binary into 50 Containers without Code Changes
expert_choice: Strangler Fig Pattern with Routing Facade & Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)
acceptable_secondary: Shared Database Direct Table Mutation between Legacy and New Apps
expert_rationale: Strangler Fig with an Anti-Corruption Layer migrates vertical slices incrementally behind a routing proxy, eliminating Big-Bang cutover risk while isolating the new domain model from legacy schema pollution.

title: Internal Internal-Tooling API Security for 4 Services
prompt: Secure an internal engineering dashboard backed by 4 backend services in a single private Kubernetes namespace. Managed by 2 developers; needs strong authentication and RBAC without heavy infrastructure.
options: API Gateway with OIDC/OAuth2 JWT Validation + K8s NetworkPolicies
Full Istio Service Mesh + SPIFFE/SPIRE Federation + Custom Envoy WASM Filters
Hardcoded Shared Static API Keys in Source Code
Custom Hand-Rolled Cryptography Protocol over Raw TCP
expert_choice: API Gateway with OIDC/OAuth2 JWT Validation + K8s NetworkPolicies
acceptable_secondary: Full Istio Service Mesh + SPIFFE/SPIRE Federation + Custom Envoy WASM Filters
expert_rationale: For 4 services and 2 developers, OIDC/OAuth2 JWT validation at the ingress gateway plus Kubernetes NetworkPolicies achieves strong security without the upgrade and debugging overhead of a full service mesh.

title: Regulatory Semiconductor Chemical Audit Ledger
prompt: Track every hazardous chemical canister movement across cleanrooms for EPA/ISO regulatory audits. Requires tamper-evident history of every state transition, who approved it, and point-in-time state reconstruction. Throughput is modest (50 events/min).
options: Event Sourcing with Append-Only Cryptographically Chained Log in PostgreSQL
Standard CRUD Overwrite Table with Last-Modified Timestamp
Public Permissionless Blockchain (Ethereum Mainnet Smart Contracts)
In-Memory Redis Cache with Periodic Snapshot
expert_choice: Event Sourcing with Append-Only Cryptographically Chained Log in PostgreSQL
acceptable_secondary: Standard CRUD Overwrite Table with Last-Modified Timestamp
expert_rationale: Event Sourcing with an append-only hash-chained table in PostgreSQL provides immutable auditability and temporal state reconstruction without external blockchain latency or CRUD state-overwrite loss.

title: Protection Against Slow Third-Party Carrier Shipping API
prompt: Our checkout/dispatch service calls 3 external freight carrier REST APIs. When one carrier's API degrades to 30s response times, it exhausts all worker threads and crashes our entire dispatch service.
options: Bulkhead Thread/Connection Pool Isolation + Circuit Breaker with Fallback Queue
Increase Global HTTP Timeout to 120 Seconds and Double Thread Pool
Rewrite Entire Dispatch System in Assembly
Synchronous Retry Loop (10 Immediate Retries on Failure)
expert_choice: Bulkhead Thread/Connection Pool Isolation + Circuit Breaker with Fallback Queue
acceptable_secondary: Increase Global HTTP Timeout to 120 Seconds and Double Thread Pool
expert_rationale: Bulkhead isolation ensures one slow carrier can only saturate its dedicated pool, while a Circuit Breaker trips fast and routes requests to an async retry queue.

title: Global Multi-Fab Read-Heavy Equipment Catalog
prompt: Serve a read-heavy equipment calibration specification catalog (99.5% reads, 0.5% writes, <50ms read latency) to engineers across 3 fabs, managed by a 3-person team.
options: Primary PostgreSQL + Read Replicas + Cache-Aside Redis
Full Event-Sourced Multi-Cluster Cassandra with Custom Paxos Engine
Single Unindexed CSV File on Shared Network Drive
Multi-Master Write-Everywhere Spanner Clone Self-Hosted
expert_choice: Primary PostgreSQL + Read Replicas + Cache-Aside Redis
acceptable_secondary: Full Event-Sourced Multi-Cluster Cassandra with Custom Paxos Engine
expert_rationale: For a 99.5% read workload and a 3-person team, PostgreSQL with Read Replicas and Cache-Aside Redis delivers <10ms reads with minimal operational complexity.

title: Large-Scale Autonomous Org (120 Engineers, 15 Domain Teams)
prompt: Scale an enterprise manufacturing analytics platform built by 120 engineers organized into 15 autonomous domain teams with dedicated platform SREs. Teams are blocked by release train conflicts on a shared monolith.
options: Domain-Aligned Microservices with API Gateway, Contract Testing & Platform PaaS
Keep Single Shared Monolith with Weekly Manual Merge Freeze
Shared Single Database with 15 Uncoordinated Apps Mutating Tables
No-Code Spreadsheet Macros
expert_choice: Domain-Aligned Microservices with API Gateway, Contract Testing & Platform PaaS
acceptable_secondary: Keep Single Shared Monolith with Weekly Manual Merge Freeze
expert_rationale: With 120 engineers across 15 teams and dedicated Platform SREs, Conway's Law and release autonomy justify domain-aligned microservices with contract testing.

title: Packaging Line Vision Inspection Event Stream (3k Cameras)
prompt: Ingest defect alert events from 3,000 high-speed optical inspection cameras on-premise with <500ms alerting latency. Managed by a lean 3-person factory IT team with no dedicated Kafka specialists.
options: NATS JetStream (Clustered Go Single-Binary) or Redpanda
Apache Kafka on Kubernetes with Strimzi Operator (KRaft mode)
Raw Self-Managed Apache Kafka + ZooKeeper + Storm Cluster
Public Cloud Google Pub/Sub over Internet
expert_choice: NATS JetStream (Clustered Go Single-Binary) or Redpanda
acceptable_secondary: Apache Kafka on Kubernetes with Strimzi Operator (KRaft mode)
expert_rationale: Mirrors the operational proportionality and on-prem sub-second latency principles: NATS JetStream or Redpanda avoids JVM/ZooKeeper complexity for a 3-person factory IT team while guaranteeing <500ms on-prem delivery.

title: Cleanroom Environmental Sensor Archive & SQL Reporting
prompt: Store 50,000 particle, temperature, and humidity readings/sec on-prem and join them with cleanroom zone and maintenance schedules stored in PostgreSQL. Maintained by a 3-person ops team.
options: TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL Hypertables + Native Compression)
ClickHouse + Separate PostgreSQL + Custom ETL Sync
Hadoop HDFS + Apache HBase + MapReduce
Plain Unpartitioned SQLite File
expert_choice: TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL Hypertables + Native Compression)
acceptable_secondary: ClickHouse + Separate PostgreSQL + Custom ETL Sync
expert_rationale: At 50k readings/sec with relational joins and a 3-person ops team, TimescaleDB provides time-series compression and native SQL joins in a single PostgreSQL footprint.

title: Internal Calibration Scheduling & Technician Portal
prompt: Build an internal web application for scheduling tool calibrations and tracking technician checklists (800 daily active users). Team of 4 developers, 3-month delivery target, no platform ops team.
options: Modular Monolith with Explicit Domain Boundaries & Single PostgreSQL
10 Microservices with Kubernetes Service Mesh & gRPC
Distributed Actor Cluster with Custom Consensus
Event-Sourced CQRS with 5 Separate Broker Clusters
expert_choice: Modular Monolith with Explicit Domain Boundaries & Single PostgreSQL
acceptable_secondary: 10 Microservices with Kubernetes Service Mesh & gRPC
expert_rationale: For 4 developers, 800 users, and a 3-month deadline with no ops team, a Modular Monolith maximizes delivery velocity and minimizes operational burden.

title: Automated Reticle Mask Qualification Pipeline (7 Steps)
prompt: Coordinate a 7-step automated reticle qualification pipeline across inspection, pellicle check, recipe verification, and stocker reservation, with automatic compensation if any verification step fails or times out.
options: Orchestrated Saga via Durable Workflow Engine (Temporal / State Machine)
Ad-hoc Peer-to-Peer Event Choreography across 7 Services
Blocking Synchronous Distributed XA Transactions
Manual Email Handoffs with Shell Scripts
expert_choice: Orchestrated Saga via Durable Workflow Engine (Temporal / State Machine)
acceptable_secondary: Ad-hoc Peer-to-Peer Event Choreography across 7 Services
expert_rationale: A 7-step workflow with timeouts and rollback compensation requires centralized Saga Orchestration to avoid unmaintainable event choreography loops.

title: Offshore Test Facility Telemetry with Intermittent Subsea Link
prompt: Collect tester machine logs and trigger local overheat shutdowns (<200ms) at an offshore test facility whose WAN connection to central headquarters experiences frequent 1-hour disconnects.
options: Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway (Local NATS Leaf / SQLite Buffer)
Cloud-Only Streaming with Synchronous HTTP POST over WAN
Centralized Cloud Rule Engine Polling Machines over VPN
Weekly USB Drive Physical Shipment
expert_choice: Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway (Local NATS Leaf / SQLite Buffer)
acceptable_secondary: Cloud-Only Streaming with Synchronous HTTP POST over WAN
expert_rationale: Local sub-200ms control loops and 1-hour WAN disconnects require an Edge-First Store-and-Forward Gateway with local rule evaluation and persistent disk buffering.

prompt: Guarantee that every committed shipment record in PostgreSQL emits an event to the internal broker without dual-write inconsistencies. Maintained by a 4-person dev team wanting minimal operational moving parts.
options: Transactional Outbox Table with Lightweight Polling Publisher
Transactional Outbox with Full Debezium + Kafka Connect Cluster
Best-Effort In-Memory Async Fire-and-Forget after DB Commit
Two-Phase Commit (2PC) across DB and Broker
expert_choice: Transactional Outbox Table with Lightweight Polling Publisher
acceptable_secondary: Transactional Outbox with Full Debezium + Kafka Connect Cluster
expert_rationale: A Transactional Outbox with a lightweight Polling Publisher guarantees transactional event delivery without requiring the 4-person team to operate Debezium and Kafka Connect.

title: Incremental Replacement of Monolithic Factory Dispatch System
prompt: Gradually modernize a mission-critical 15-year-old factory dispatch system over 12 months with zero cleanroom downtime and strict protection of the new domain model from legacy table schemas.

12-Month Feature Freeze & Big-Bang Cutover
Direct Bi-Directional Database Triggers Mutating Legacy Tables
Decompile Legacy Binary and Auto-Transpile to Microservices
expert_choice: Strangler Fig Pattern with Routing Facade & Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)
acceptable_secondary: Direct Bi-Directional Database Triggers Mutating Legacy Tables
expert_rationale: Strangler Fig with a Routing Facade and ACL enables low-risk vertical slice migration while keeping the new domain model decoupled from legacy schemas.

title: Authentication & Authorization for 3 Internal Analytics APIs
prompt: Secure 3 internal yield-reporting REST services deployed in a single Kubernetes cluster and maintained by a 3-person team. Needs corporate SSO integration and role-based access control.

Multi-Cluster Istio Service Mesh + SPIFFE/SPIRE + Custom HSM Sidecars
Unauthenticated Internal Endpoints (Trust Corporate LAN)
Custom Proprietary Token Encryption Scheme
expert_choice: API Gateway with OIDC/OAuth2 JWT Validation + K8s NetworkPolicies
acceptable_secondary: Multi-Cluster Istio Service Mesh + SPIFFE/SPIRE + Custom HSM Sidecars
expert_rationale: For 3 internal services and a 3-person team, OIDC/OAuth2 JWT validation at the API Gateway plus K8s NetworkPolicies provides strong security with low operational overhead.

title: Export-Controlled Photomask Custody Chain Ledger
prompt: Record every custody handoff of export-controlled photomasks with immutable non-repudiation, full historical audit replay, and cryptographic tamper detection (throughput: 20 events/min, 3-person team).

Mutable SQL Table with UPDATE Statements
Self-Hosted 20-Node Hyperledger Fabric Consortium Cluster
Local Text Log Files on Application Server

expert_rationale: Event Sourcing with an append-only hash-chained log in PostgreSQL meets strict tamper-evident audit requirements while staying operable for a 3-person team.

title: Isolating Flaky Legacy SAP RFC Integration in Order Service
prompt: Our order API calls a legacy SAP endpoint that periodically hangs for 45 seconds during batch runs, causing thread starvation and taking down unrelated read endpoints in our service.
options: Bulkhead Thread/Connection Pool Isolation + Circuit Breaker with Fallback Queue
Remove All Timeouts and Add 500 Worker Threads
Synchronous Blocking Retry Loop on Main Request Thread
Restart Kubernetes Pod Every 5 Minutes via Cron

acceptable_secondary: Remove All Timeouts and Add 500 Worker Threads
expert_rationale: Bulkhead pool isolation protects unrelated endpoints from thread starvation, while a Circuit Breaker with fallback queue handles SAP batch brownouts gracefully.

Custom Sharded ScyllaDB + Kafka + Elasticsearch + GraphDB
Single Uncached SQL Server with Complex 12-Table Joins on Every Read
Client-Side 50GB Full Database Download on Login

acceptable_secondary: Custom Sharded ScyllaDB + Kafka + Elasticsearch + GraphDB
expert_rationale: PostgreSQL + Read Replicas + Cache-Aside Redis easily achieves <30ms read latency for a 99% read workload while respecting the 3-person team's operational capacity.

18 Services Sharing One Tightly Coupled Relational Schema
Manual FTP Deployment to Shared VM
expert_choice: Domain-Aligned Microservices with API Gateway, Contract Testing & Platform PaaS
acceptable_secondary: 18 Services Sharing One Tightly Coupled Relational Schema
expert_rationale: With 150 developers in 18 squads and a dedicated 10-person Platform Engineering team, domain-aligned microservices with contract testing enable independent deployment velocity and fault isolation.
